title: Language Models Entangle Language and Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Translating culture-neutral, open-ended advice-seeking queries into multiple languages (English, Hindi, Chinese, Swahili, Hebrew, Brazilian Portuguese), generating responses, and using an LLM-as-a-Judge to score and compare the overall quality of the responses across these languages.

Translating non-English model responses back to English and using an LLM-as-a-Judge to classify the embedded cultural context (e.g., Western, Indian, Chinese). The study also evaluates factual accuracy on a translated subset of the CulturalBench dataset to measure how cultural knowledge performance varies by language.
